thread.title: TSM Stock Wavers As Contract Chipmaker Offers Weak Outlook

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: TSM Stock Wavers As Contract Chipmaker Offers Weak Outlook

organizations.name: tsm stock wavers as contract chipmaker offers weak outlook taiwan semiconductor manufacturing

text:
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing ( TSM ) early Thursday posted in-line sales for the fourth quarter, but its revenue guidance for the current quarter was well below views. TSM stock fell on the news, but rebounded in afternoon trading.
X The contract chipmaker generated $9.4 billion in revenue in the December quarter , hitting the midpoint of its guidance. For the March quarter, it expects sales of $7.3 billion to $7.4 billion. Analysts had been projecting $8.1 billion for the first quarter.
The chip foundry, known as TSMC, finds itself tied to the fortunes of two struggling companies. Its largest customer, Apple ( AAPL ), has seen disappointing sales of its current-generation smartphones, the iPhone XR and XS series. Huawei Technologies, its second largest customer, has been the target of U.S. sanctions because of spying accusations and doing business with Iran.
TSM stock fell as much as 2.3% in morning trading on the stock market today . It ended the regular session up 1.8% to 36.28. TSM stock trades in the U.S. as American depositary receipts. It hit an all-time high of 46.57 in January 2018.
It earned 63 cents per American depositary receipt in the fourth quarter, matching views. On a year-over-year basis, earnings rose 0.7% while sales climbed 4.4% in local currency.
 7-Nanometer Chips Boost Q4 Results "Our fourth-quarter business benefited from the strong demand for our 7-nanometer technology covering both mobile and high-performance computing applications," Chief Financial Officer Lora Ho said in a news release .
Shipments of 7-nanometer chips accounted for 23% of total wafer revenue for TSMC in the fourth quarter. The industry measures circuit widths on chips in nanometers, or one-billionth of a meter.
"Moving into first quarter 2019, we anticipate our business will be dampened by the overall weakening of the macroeconomic outlook, mobile product seasonality, and high levels of inventory in the semiconductor supply chain," Ho said.
TSMC guided to a gross profit margin of 43% to 45% in the first quarter. That compares with 47.7% in the fourth quarter.
Price Target Cut On TSM Stock TSMC's dismal outlook pulled down the broader chip sector for a time. The Philadelphia semiconductor index, known as SOX, rebounded with the broader market. It ended the day up 1.2%.
Susquehanna Financial Group analyst Mehdi Hosseini said the chipmaker's guidance suggested weaker data-center demand ahead.
Hosseini reiterated his positive rating on TSM stock, but lowered his price target to 44 from 50. The company is well positioned to capitalize on megatrends in artificial intelligence and 5G wireless networks, he said.
